The 2026 Presidents Cup will be the 16th edition of the Presidents Cup golf competition, being held September 24 to 27 at Medinah Country Club in Medinah, Illinois.
Team qualification and selection
Both teams have 12 players.

The United States team features the six players who earn the most FedEx Cup points from the events from January 1, 2025 through August 23, 2026 BMW Championship and six captain's picks.
